title: Senator Lisa Blunt Rochester seeks answers from Roger Goodell regarding the Jalen Hurts situation

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Senator Lisa Blunt Rochester seeks answers from Roger Goodell regarding the Jalen Hurts situation
sources.description: The NFL and the Eagles hope to run out the clock as to the Jalen Hurts situation, in the hopes that the media and fans will turn their attention to the next story that grabs our collective attention.
